senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עָנָה II)submissive, meek, kind, patient.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 6b:7">Ber. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>אי ע׳ אי חסיד וכ׳</he> woe for the loss of the meek, … of the pious man, the disciple of Abraham!; <cite ref="Sotah 48b:9">Sot. 48ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 71a:13">Kidd. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מוסרין אותו אלא למי שצנוע וע׳</he> we do not communicate it (the Divine Name) except to one who is chaste and meek; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲנָוִים</he>.
Y. Taan. III, 66ᶜ ענן שהוא עושה בריות ע׳ אלו לאלו the cloud is named ʿanan, because it (the rainfall) makes men kind to one another; Gen. R. s. 13; Yalk. Gen. 20; Yalk. Ps. 883 עניים (Var. ענוים).
